reason: The orthorhombic cell is strongly supported by peak positions, but exact structure recovery is not established. No comparable whole-pattern Rwp was supplied, and the final validation only showed that observed peak positions coincide with reflections of the indexed cell; it did not demonstrate an adequate intensity/profile fit. The submitted Lu8 model has only 17.6 A^3 per Lu and an implausibly short 1.826 A Lu-Lu contact. Its coordinates came from ad hoc extracted-intensity objectives, and the trajectory's physically better four-Lu P2_1 model was nearly competitive (objective 0.0495 versus about 0.0467 for the retained eight-Lu P2_1 model on the broader comparison), so Z and the periodic realization remain materially ambiguous. The nominal symmetry is also inconsistent: the CIF declares P1 while its coordinates are asserted to recover P2_1. A further attempt with physically constrained models and a genuine whole-pattern refinement/comparison is warranted.
